{"type": "obligation", "text": "This policy shall govern the use of all technological equipment, software, hardware, and related materials, electronic devices, and network systems.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "This policy", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Using technological resources for purposes other than those for which they were intended is prohibited.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Responsibility for ethical behavior rests with all individuals who use AACPS technological resources.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "all individuals who use AACPS technological resources", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "AACPS retains the right to monitor file server space and review materials on user accounts when a legitimate business need exists or as otherwise necessary to promote the interests of AACPS.", "force": "permission", "binds": "AACPS", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "when a legitimate business need exists"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The Superintendent is authorized to develop regulations to implement this policy.", "force": "permission", "binds": "The Superintendent", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act", "cited_instrument": "Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)"},
